# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in spantrack.

1. Open an issue before large changes, so we can agree on the approach.
2. Keep changes small and focused; one logical change per pull request.
3. Add tests for what you change, and make sure `pytest` passes.
4. Keep `ruff check` and `pyright` clean.

By contributing, you agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
